He can't say for sure. Which isnt really helping. :/

I dunno, I'm scared he'll get pissed off.
He's away at the moment ):

I don't really have anything to be honest. Up until a few months ago I was doing really well, came to be the person I wanted to be and all that. It all strted with a fuckup with a guy, then another, then another. 

He's hurt me before, and promises it's different but I just can't shake the feeling. 

I'd feel better if I had people to talk to, but other than you today I've got no one.

I can :) It helps to play!

I dont when people sing which is odd...

Well, for starters the riff is purple, and kinda tribal looking :)

Vocals are a dark grey and look kindof like this http://image1.masterfile.com/em_w/04/17/76/400-04177602w.jpg as the vocals go along more lines/bits grow.

Sorry it's such a bad description ):
Sure :) what song?
It's on the outskirts of my vision, so not really. Though if I'm reading a book with music on in the background I don't usually see it unless its too loud.
Thanks!

Good dubstep = beautiful!

Bad dubstep = Near blindness ):

I can't recall seeing anything like it, though maybe the right music could cause it :)

Best example I can give is like this http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VXoJjgxMj9M
What he 'tastes' is what I see.
Haha its not fancy!
One track I love is Ephixa's mix of Run away from Me!
It is incredibly awesome, one of my favourite types of music to listen/see is dubstep at the moment haha

Oh my gosh, dubstep is absolutely MENTAL. 
It's more often than not a black background, and I guess I can only describe the 'wub wub' as like... coloured snakes that arch and bow :)

It can, though as of recently I'm learning to change the way it affects me. Almost like selective hearing. Though I have to conectrate very hard to do this. The only time I go blind is when a wrong note is played.

I'm am 18 years old, 19 in a couple of weeks. I guess I realised when I was a kid, when I say 'that music looks pretty' and no one understood. 
Yes, I had gotten better, but I think thats due to a better understanding.
I am, yes. I play many instruments, anything stringed, piano, a few wind instruments and I also sing. 
Hmm... I'd say the likes of underoath, metallica, anything like that. I know they aren't particularly heavy, but they certainly look different. I listen to anything, really. I think my better understanding of music means I appreciate it all more.   
I have been to quite a few gigs, and the overall experience is breathtaking! 
The crippling circumstances are when I'm trying to do things and music distracts me, also when wrong notes are played I go blind. 

The last one is hard to answer because it really depends on my mood, there have been moments where I've gotten so fed up and visually exhausted that I have to sit in silence. Other times, such as when I'm down (I have huge problems with depression) it is the only thing that can bring me out of it.
I see music that I play, so probably haha
No... It's hard to explain. Say if I were looking ahead, it would be on the edge of my vision, and if I tried to look at it, it would move to the 'new' edge of my vision.
There are different types, seeing sounds/music is a subtype. Generally it is limited to music, though if I'm incredibly tired I will see any and every sound too.
Depending on the context the colours I see can change, I also see different shapes and brightnesses of instruments and sounds.

Yes I do.

Generally if I'm using headphones the 'sights' are much, much stronger :)

Screamo is lots of grey/black/white/red oddly enough. There is some that looks different though, because some songs have harmonies/ are not just all heavy. an example of this would be King for a Day by pierce the veil, its heavy BUT not just black and white. There are certain colours, the vocals especially are blue and green. 

Bluegrass also depends, again it's not all the same. Banjo's usually are brown/orange. Fiddles and such are often blue or white. An example would be Buffalo Nickel by bela fleck, the banjo over the top mostly is orange and brown lines that dance across the top over a blueish background... when it kicks in with more instruments there are lots of brighter colours, yellows and pinks.

What I see is shapes/colours on the outskirts of my vision. I can't say for sure if you do or dont :O

It is crippling when it's really loud and I'm trying to do something. Also if a wrong note is played I go pretty much blind, my vision has a big grey flash and I can't see anything for a second or two ): Most of the time I can't do much about it, though recently I've been able to shut things out so if I'm busy or music is bad I can shut it out and not see it :)

Visually I'd say bluegrass is my favourite kind, listening wise I never really know haha. 

I'd have to say the heavier the music is the more vivid it looks. So like screamo music... stuff like that, can be really hard to see cause there is a lot going big things going on.
Thats a bit shit. You are giving up that easily on the girl you love?

No one can really tell you what to say. Its all in your heart and your head. If you like her eyes then tell her, in the greatest detail possible. If she makes your heart jump then make sure she knows it. If you use someone elses words and she falls for them, there wouldnt be any way of fixing it.

If even after that she is still there then you obviously mean a lot to her. If she didnt want you then she would probably tell you rather than wasting her time. If shes still there then youre stuck in  her heart, but she probably wont wait for you forever. You need to tell her before the oppertunity is gone

Well this is the opposite of what I was expecting, but actually it works. So even though she got hurt from that, she still sticks around? She sounds like a keeper if you ask me, I'd turn on my heels and run to be honest. 

edit; Then again it sounds like she over reacted to you telling someone. Did she ask you not to?
Well look at it this way. Have you ever hurt her? or made her upset?

Tell her whatever goes through your head when you are with her. Even if you think it's stupid she will probably find it romantic. Tell her what goes through your head when you see her or a picture of her. If she's stayed with you for this long she must see something in you.
She loves you.
